title: Flame of Farrak (object)
wikitext:
[[File:Flame of Farrak.png|thumb|The Flame of Farrak.]]

The '''Flame of Farrak''' is located in [[Zul'Farrak]], next to [[Chief Ukorz Sandscalp]].

It can be interacted with to obtain the item [[Flame of Farrak]], which has a ten minute duration and can be used to bypass the ancient embalming of [[Zel'jeb the Ancient]] if the party does not have a member capable of dealing fire damage.
